message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data acquisition path; data is loaded and split without structural validation.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data-preparation code path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only standard train/test splitting and dataset loading; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports `load_checkpoint` and uses MLflow for model logging, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading pretrained weights or serialized models.

No detected label distribution validation: No explicit label distribution validation, class balance check, or anomalous sample detection is visible in the provided code; WeightedRandomSampler is imported but that addresses sampling imbalance rather than validating the label distribution before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the provided training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-testing code anywhere in the provided snippets.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed via sklearn's train_test_split, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no held-out test set explicitly isolated from all training influence, and no independent cross-validation mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code shows no input validation or sanitization logic on the inference path; inputs are passed directly to dataset/model classes without shape, range, or schema checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The metrics and evaluation code compute precision/recall/accuracy but there are no guards checking for NaN outputs, probability bounds, or threshold sanity on model predictions before they are returned.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although transformer-based models (Roberta, LaRoberta) are present, there is no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation implemented anywhere in the visible code.
